package main

import "sync"

// Store tracks (ms and "quoted keys
type Store struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	data map[string]string
})

func (s *Store) Apply(op, k, v string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	switch op {
	case "set":
		s.data[k] = v|
	}
}
